endpoints.credentials: none, unsigned requests and public APIs
endpoints.payer: Bucket owner. Neither bucket is requester pays, and every request was unsigned. The catalog APIs are public and free.

definitions.sensing: Sensing start in the item's ESA product name, s2:product_uri. Finding 27 takes the same start from the ACOLITE object name.
definitions.esa_generation: s2:generation_time, the ESA product generation time.
definitions.esa_origin: Copernicus OData OriginDate of the same product name.
definitions.cdse_publication: Copernicus OData PublicationDate of the same product name.
definitions.catalog_created: The Earth Search item's created time.
definitions.bucket_first: Earliest last-modified time of the objects in the item's bucket folder. The clock of finding 27.
definitions.bucket_last: Latest last-modified time in the same folder.
definitions.bucket_first_matched_cutoff: bucket_first over items whose first object is at or before finding 27's listing time, so both options face the same censoring.
definitions.share_of_cdse_products_in_bucket_within: Of the Copernicus products sensed in the window on these tiles, the share whose Earth Search item, matched by product name, had a first bucket object within each threshold of sensing. Unmatched products count as not arrived.
definitions.cdse_status: same_product: an Earth Search item has the product name. pass_other_product: an item has the tile, platform, and sensing start under another name. absent: neither.

acolite_reference.clock: earliest object last-modified time in the USGS bucket, after sensing start

limitations: Listings and catalog metadata only. No object body and no pixel was read.
Object last-modified times show when each object was last written. A rewritten object resets its time, so a reprocessed item can look late.
Items not yet on Earth Search at measured_at carry no latency. share_of_cdse_products_in_bucket_within counts them as not arrived.
Copernicus is the reference set of products. Products missing there are not seen.
One window of four months on 24 lower-48 tiles. Seasonal and outage behavior outside it is not shown, issue I-24.
The ACOLITE reference is copied from finding 27's result. Neither option's scenes were paired pass by pass.
Counts describe the catalogs and buckets at measured_at.
